name: dd-of-device-without-if-is-denied
note: `dd of=/dev/sdb` (no if=) surfaces disk.device:write for the policy deny, AND is caught by the compiled hard-stop hs.dd-to-device (which keys on of=/dev/* regardless of if=). The hard-stop runs first, so this resolves to gommage either way; hard_stop is intentionally not asserted so the fixture is robust to which layer denies.
